versions.subject: Added image_load rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: 
      - '\MpCmdRun.exe'
      - '\NisSrv.exe'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: 
      - 'mpclient.dll'
filter:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\Windows Defender\'
      - 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Platform\'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\MpCmdRun.exe", "*\\NisSrv.exe") ImageLoaded="*mpclient.dll" NOT (ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\*", "C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\*"))
